H1.problem: The brand, seven destinations, sign-out and duplicate role strip take an estimated 373px before page content, reducing the first-screen task area.
H1.fix: Keep the brand/role and sign-out in one compact row; use a 44px-high horizontally scrollable navigation row; hide only the duplicate role-only topbar on phones. Preserve all destinations.
H1.implementation: Approved shared fix. Compact mobile parent header retains brand, role, sign-out and every scrollable destination; viewport check confirms header under180px.

H2.problem: My Money is clipped and Week-end recap is offscreen in the horizontal strip; these destinations are difficult to discover.
H2.fix: At ≤760px use a three-column, two-row grid for all six destinations, wrap labels, keep each target ≥44px high, and reserve 120px bottom clearance. Preserve desktop sidebar.
H2.implementation: Approved shared fix. All six destinations fit a3×2 phone grid, each target at least44px high; bottom clearance adjusted.

M1.problem: Faint empty-field outlines are hard to locate. Source color #bcc2b7 measures 1.82:1 against white; this is a likely WCAG AA non-text contrast issue where the border is the identifying cue. Secondary buttons have readable labels and are not automatically failures.
M1.fix: Use #778477 for essential field outlines (target ≥3:1 against white and page background); preserve lighter decorative card dividers and existing focus outlines.
M1.implementation: Approved shared fix. New #778477 input outline measures3.92:1 against white and3.65:1 against page background; decorative borders unchanged.

M2.problem: Form labels look small relative to 16px input values. Source confirms 12px labels. Contrast is sufficient; small size remains a readability concern.
M2.fix: Increase field labels from 12px to 14px, line-height 1.5; keep inputs at16px and min-height44px.
M2.implementation: Approved shared fix. Labels now14px/1.5; browser computed style checked.

M3.problem: The outlined action sits lower than the filled action in both balance dashboards; the pair reads as unrelated controls.
M3.fix: Set margin-top:0 on buttons inside .live-actions and align-items:stretch. Apply only to Overview/Home actions.
M3.implementation: Dashboard action buttons have zero top margin and matching stretch alignment.

M4.problem: The 88px photo plus gap leaves an estimated 200px-wide mobile detail column. Rules, dates and hashes wrap repeatedly; metadata also looks small.
M4.fix: At ≤480px put a 72px photo above full-width details; set detail paragraphs to14px/1.5 with8px vertical margins, retain headings16px and disclosure targets min-height44px. Keep desktop side-by-side rows.
M4.implementation: Phone rows use72px photos above full-width details; metadata14px/1.5 and evidence disclosure targets44px.

M5.problem: Desktop shows two successive, very long category lists despite available width; phone category labels/examples are dense.
M5.fix: Add a rules-form class; at ≥1000px place Needs/Wants fieldsets side by side. Keep numeric fields and validation full width and phone fieldsets stacked. Names14px, examples13px/1.5, row padding8px0, clickable label min-height44px.
M5.implementation: Rules-only form class enables two desktop category columns; mobile stays stacked; names/examples enlarged with padded label targets.

M6.problem: The validation message is below30 category choices, far from the invalid amount at the top.
M6.fix: Move the existing validation node immediately after the three numeric fields and before the category fieldsets. Preserve text, conditions and submit handler.
M6.implementation: Same alert moved before categories and made sticky12px from viewport top. Follow-up source review identified an offscreen-submit risk; final captures/assertions verify the alert stays visible after Save at the bottom on phone and desktop. Validation conditions/wording unchanged.

M7.problem: The Savings/My Money amount uses ordinary body styling and competes with explanatory text; the primary fact is difficult to scan.
M7.fix: Give the existing amount paragraph a dedicated class with24px, weight650, line-height1.4, tabular numerals and12px vertical spacing. Keep simulated PHP and Testnet XLM qualifiers visible.
M7.implementation: Existing money formatter and qualifiers retained; dedicated paragraph uses24px/650 weight and tabular numerals.

M8.problem: Camera failure is visually similar to ready guidance and a disabled capture button looks like it is still waiting. Selected/missing-photo messages are small, plain helper text.
M8.fix: Set camera status and photo-selection text to14px/1.5 with12px padded surfaces; add an error class in the existing camera failure path and use the existing error palette; use not-allowed cursor for unavailable capture. Do not change acquisition or submission behavior.
M8.implementation: Existing failure path adds presentation classes only; status/selection use14px padded surfaces and failure uses existing error palette. Disabled unavailable capture uses not-allowed cursor.

M9.problem: Unstyled hashes dominate Pay a seller history; narrow evidence text is difficult to distinguish from human-readable outcomes.
M9.fix: Apply12–13px monospace, line-height1.6, padding12px and a neutral inset background to existing transaction-reference/evidence paragraphs. Keep overflow-wrap:anywhere and all text. Add a payment-history class with20px spacing.
M9.implementation: Existing hashes gain wrapping monospace inset surfaces; history gets20px separation. Every hash, outcome and action remains present.

M10.problem: Savings/My Money/recap instruct the user to submit a product photo; parent Savings/Withdrawal describe distribution. These subtitles describe another task.
M10.fix: Replace with page-specific descriptions only after explicit copy-meaning authorization. Current task prohibits changing copy meaning; preserve these strings in this pass.
M10.implementation: Fixing the misleading inherited subtitles changes copy meaning, which the user explicitly excluded. Requires a separate copy decision.

M11.problem: Explanatory paragraphs in payment, rules and weekly panels have tightly packed lines compared with page descriptions, especially when wrapping on phones.
M11.fix: Set preview-panel direct prose to line-height1.55 and max-width75ch; retain existing paragraph order and12px inter-element gap. Do not expand already-legible dashboard descriptions.
M11.implementation: Approved shared fix. Panel prose has1.55 line-height and direct explanatory paragraphs a75ch maximum measure.

L1.problem: The full-page login image extends below the viewport with blank space; source forces an844px card plus the installation bar. Signup also has oversized gaps around the role explanation.
L1.fix: Remove the mobile card min-height844px; use content-based card height and zero margins on the role explanation inside the form. Preserve existing16px form gap and44px targets.
L1.implementation: Removed844px card minimum and redundant role-description margins. Default installation bar is accounted for, but expanded manual-help height is variable and can still extend the document beyond one viewport; no shared PWA behavior was changed.

L2.problem: Paid and configuration-required entries have little separation, making it harder to tell which message belongs to which amount.
L2.fix: Give .live-activity-item entries16px padding, a1px existing divider-color border,12px radius and16px separation. Preserve both status messages.
L2.implementation: Existing Velo history articles have16px padding,12px radius and separate outlined surfaces; existing gap plus4px adjacent margin gives16px separation.

L3.problem: The standalone offline page uses a brighter teal and bluer background than the connected app.
L3.fix: Use the established app teal/background in offline CSS in a later cache-aware delivery change. Leave this low-impact difference in place here to avoid changing service-worker delivery behavior.
L3.implementation: Offline document palette retained because updating the cached document also needs a service-worker cache-version/delivery change, excluded from this visual-only pass.
